title: backlog-groomer input
description: Required dispatch-context keys for the backlog-groomer role, per agents/backlog-groomer.md Inputs section. Consumed by callers for pre-dispatch validation only -- never appended to the prompt or shown to the LLM.

identity.description: Operator's own assignee value in this beads DB (email or username). Derived from git config when not supplied explicitly.

scope.description: Optional narrowing: a bead id to groom the subtree of, a priority floor, or a count cap. Default: all open/in_progress beads assigned to identity.

mode.description: Which of the three usage modes to run. Default: all three.

include-others.description: If true, other assignees' beads are loaded for context and reported in a visibly separate section, never merged into identity's buckets or mutated.

dry-run.description: If true, mutations are proposed as exact bd commands only. If false, warranted mutations are executed, each paired with an evidence/reasoning note.
